mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0.00) FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID' AND is_deleted = FALSE AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at <= #{endTime}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID' AND is_deleted = FALSE AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at <= #{endTime}

SELECT p.id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, CAST(COALESCE(single_sales.sold_qty, 0) AS SIGNED) AS singleSold, CAST(COALESCE(combo_sales.sold_qty, 0) AS SIGNED) AS comboSold, CAST((COALESCE(single_sales.sold_qty, 0) + COALESCE(combo_sales.sold_qty, 0)) AS SIGNED) AS quantitySold FROM product p JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_qty FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND o.is_deleted = FALSE AND o.created_at >= #{startTime} AND o.created_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY oi.product_id ) single_sales ON p.id = single_sales.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oio.selected_product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_qty FROM order_item_option oio JOIN order_item oi ON oio.order_item_id = oi.id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND o.is_deleted = FALSE AND o.created_at >= #{startTime} AND o.created_at <= #{endTime} AND oio.selected_product_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY oio.selected_product_id ) combo_sales ON p.id = combo_sales.selected_product_id WHERE p.is_deleted = FALSE AND (single_sales.sold_qty IS NOT NULL OR combo_sales.sold_qty IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY quantitySold DESC, productId ASC

SELECT id AS productId, name AS productName, stock, stock_alert_threshold AS stockAlertThreshold, status FROM product WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND (stock <= stock_alert_threshold OR status = 'SOLD_OUT') ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'SOLD_OUT' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, stock ASC, id ASC
